github_write.description: The actual runtime/provider can perform GitHub write operations (branch, commit, PR).

message_publish.description: The runtime can publish an externally visible message to a destination-agnostic channel.

discord_send.description: The runtime can send a message to Discord specifically.

network_access.description: The runtime permits the outbound network access a skill's operation requires.

repository_evidence.description: The runtime can access supplied or live repository evidence (history, diffs, files) to draft from.

github_write.description: The user/task has authorized GitHub write operations.

github_merge.description: The user/task has specifically authorized PR merge, separate from authorizing PR delivery.

message_publish.description: The user/task has authorized message publication.

discord_send.description: The user/task has authorized sending a message to Discord specifically.

git_diff_read.description: The runtime can inspect real repository diffs via a callable tool.
